decisions.division: Medical grade Manuka honey and dressings
decisions.why: Activon Tube/Tulle and Algivon Plus Ribbon are medical-grade manuka honey advanced wound dressings.
Eclypse and Eclypse Adherent/Boot/Foot are superabsorbent advanced wound dressings.
Advazorb foam dressing range (Areola, Silfix, Heel variants) are advanced wound dressings.
Silflex is a silicone wound contact layer dressing, an advanced dressing product.
AdvaGel is a hydrogel wound dressing within Advancis's advanced dressings range.
